data.long_meaning: From the Arabic word 'Haras' which means 'brave', 'valiant', or 'strong'. This name is a reminder of the courage and strength that one should strive to possess in their daily life, in accordance with Islamic teachings. The name AlHaris carries the meaning “The Brave One” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose AlHaris usually hope their child will grow to embody the brave one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
